game: 귀로 (가제) — 격자 이동 하드코어 탈출 로그라이크
scope: First prototype only (post sections 10–11). Not a full production art set.
howToUse: For each item send common, then a blank line, then style[item.type] with {frame} and {scale} replaced from the item, then a blank line, then item.prompt. Attach item.refs as reference images when the tool accepts them; if it cannot, open them and match by eye. Never edit prompts silently; if one must change, change it here. Make player-dog first and use its preview as the reference for everything else.
common: Pixel art for a top-down three-quarter view 2D tile-based roguelike set in an abandoned Korean walled town (eupseong) overrun by ghosts. Mood: dark, tense and grounded, NOT horror and NOT gore: ash-gray roof tiles and blue shadows outdoors, near-black with orange torchlight underground, warm campfire orange at the camp outside the walls. Crafted 16-bit style: a 1-pixel near-black outline around every silhouette, flat cel shading with 2 or 3 tones per colour, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering, no glow, no soft shadows, no texture noise. The art is drawn on an exact pixel grid and enlarged with nearest-neighbour, so every art pixel is one crisp solid square block of the same size. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or signature anywhere.

style.character: CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET. The image is a 3-row by 4-column grid of 12 equal cells. Each cell holds exactly ONE {frame} pixel frame enlarged x{scale}. Rows top to bottom: row 1 facing DOWN toward the viewer, row 2 facing RIGHT (side view), row 3 facing UP (back view). Columns left to right: idle standing, walk step A, walk step B, attack (a short lunge with the leading arm thrust toward the facing direction). Same character, same size, same proportions and the same feet line in every cell; feet rest on the bottom edge of the cell; the figure fills 80–90% of the cell height. Everything outside the figure is one flat solid magenta #FF00FF: no floor, cast shadow, frame lines or labels. The character is a two-legged animal person about 2.5 heads tall, head and ears readable at 1x size, 16 colours or fewer.
style.creature: CREATURE SPRITE SHEET. The image is a 4-row by 4-column grid of 16 equal square cells. Each cell holds exactly ONE {frame} pixel frame enlarged x{scale}. Rows 1–3 top to bottom: facing DOWN, facing RIGHT, facing UP. Columns left to right: idle, move A, move B, attack. Row 4 left to right: hurt (facing down), dead lying on its side, then two empty magenta cells. Same creature, same size, same ground line in every cell. Everything outside the creature is one flat solid magenta #FF00FF: no floor, cast shadow, frame lines or labels. 16 colours or fewer.
style.sheet2x2: SPRITE SHEET. The image is a 2x2 grid of four equal square cells. Each cell holds exactly ONE {frame} pixel frame enlarged x{scale}, centred horizontally with the feet or base on the bottom edge of the cell. The four frames are listed in the prompt in order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Same subject, same size in every cell. Everything outside the subject is one flat solid magenta #FF00FF: no floor, cast shadow, frame lines or labels. 16 colours or fewer.
style.tiles: TILESET SHEET. The image is a 4-row by 4-column grid of 16 equal square cells, each cell exactly ONE 32x32 pixel tile enlarged x8 (256x256 image pixels). Tiles fill their cells edge to edge: no gaps, no separator lines, no magenta, no labels. Ground tiles repeat seamlessly with themselves on all four sides. Walls use the top-down three-quarter convention: a 'wall top' tile and a 'wall front' tile that stack vertically. Flat colours, 32 colours or fewer in the whole sheet, no characters, no creatures. Cells are numbered in the prompt left to right, top to bottom, 1 to 16.
style.icons: ICON SHEET. The image is a 4-row by 4-column grid of 16 equal square cells, each cell exactly ONE 16x16 pixel icon enlarged x16 (256x256 image pixels), centred in its cell. Everything outside the icon is one flat solid magenta #FF00FF. Each icon has a 1-pixel dark outline and a bold silhouette readable at 1x size, 12 colours or fewer per icon. Cells are numbered in the prompt left to right, top to bottom, 1 to 16.
style.objects: OBJECT SHEET. The image is a 2-column by 3-row grid of six equal square cells, each cell exactly ONE 64x64 pixel object enlarged x8 (512x512 image pixels). Each object is seen top-down three-quarter like the tiles and sits on a 32-pixel grid so it occupies a 2x2 tile footprint, base on the bottom edge of the cell. Everything outside the object is one flat solid magenta #FF00FF. 24 colours or fewer. Cells are numbered in the prompt left to right, top to bottom, 1 to 6.

items.name: 수색꾼 개 (플레이어)
items.prompt: The player character: a two-legged DOG person, a searcher who enters the ghost town for loot. Cream and tan short fur, floppy ears hanging beside the face, a clear muzzle with a dark nose, a short tail. Plain undyed hemp tunic with a rope belt, dark trousers, straw sandals, a small cloth pouch at the hip. No weapon: the leading hand is held slightly forward and open so a separate weapon sprite can be drawn over it. Expression alert and wary, not cute-cartoonish. The facing-up row shows the back of the head, both ears and the tail. Walk frames swing the arms and legs; the attack frame is a short lunge with the leading arm thrust forward.

items.name: 수색꾼 고양이 (플레이어)
items.prompt: The other player character: a two-legged CAT person, same body size, proportions and feet line as the dog reference. Gray tabby fur with darker stripes, pointed upright ears, a slim face with a small pink nose, a long tail raised in a curve behind the body and never hidden. The same hemp tunic and straw sandals as the dog but with a dark indigo sash so the two are told apart at a glance. No weapon: the leading hand is open and slightly forward. The facing-up row shows the back of the head, both pointed ears and the tail. Same four columns as the dog: idle, walk A, walk B, attack lunge.

items.name: 떠돌이 패 개 (손도끼)
items.prompt: A rival searcher, a scruffy brown mutt DOG person with one torn ear, same size and feet line as the player reference. Ragged dark-gray patched clothes under a worn leather vest, a frayed scarf, a bulging sack on the back. Unlike the player this enemy HOLDS its weapon: a short hand axe. Walk frames carry the axe low; the attack frame swings the axe down toward the facing direction. Mean, hungry look; no blood.

items.name: 떠돌이 패 고양이 (창)
items.prompt: A rival searcher, a lean black CAT person with a notched ear and yellow eyes, same size and feet line as the player reference. Ragged clothes with a hint of chain mail at the chest, a rope-wrapped spear held two-handed, a small sack. The attack frame thrusts the spear far forward so the tip extends well past the body (it reaches two tiles). Walk frames hold the spear upright. Wary, feral look; no blood.

items.name: 수류견
items.prompt: Suryugyeon, a fast dog-like beast from a Korean folklore record: a lean four-legged animal on all fours (NOT a person), long legs, a narrow head, slate-gray short fur with a darker back, ribs faintly showing, pale yellow glowing eyes, a thin whip tail, no collar. A wild hunting beast, not a pet and not a wolf costume. Move A and move B are a stretched running gait; the attack frame lunges with jaws open to bite low. The hurt frame flinches; the dead frame lies on its side with eyes closed, no blood.

items.name: 귀봉변괴
items.prompt: Gwibong-byeongoe, a folklore thing that lies still like a wooden club and suddenly charges anyone who reaches for it. Four frames. 1 (top-left): STILL — an old dark-wood club or pestle lying on the ground, drawn like an ordinary pickup item, small and harmless, about 20 pixels long, centred. 2 (top-right): WOBBLE — the same club shifted one pixel and tilted slightly, otherwise identical. 3 (bottom-left): LUNGE — the club rears up on end and its grain splits open into a wide wooden mouth with small peg teeth and two knot-hole eyes, leaning toward the viewer. 4 (bottom-right): HURT — the opened club cracked along the grain and recoiling. Wood tones only, no blood.

items.name: 어둑서니 (작을 때)
items.prompt: Eodukseoni in its SMALL form: a shadow creature that grows when feared and shrinks in torchlight. A rounded blob of dark blue-black about 24 pixels tall with wispy, slightly ragged edges, two pale yellow eye slits and no mouth. Draw it with solid opaque pixels (the game adds transparency). Four frames: 1 idle; 2 idle with the eye slits narrowed to a blink; 3 attack, stretching one arm-like strand of shadow toward the viewer; 4 hurt, squashed smaller and dimmer.

items.name: 어둑서니 (클 때)
items.prompt: Eodukseoni in its BIG form, the same shadow creature as the small reference grown into a towering dark mass, 64 pixels wide and up to 96 tall: jagged shoulders, the two pale yellow eye slits high up, two long arms of shadow hanging down, the base widening into a pool of darkness. Solid opaque dark blue-black pixels with a slightly lighter blue edge tone. Four frames: 1 idle; 2 idle swaying one pixel; 3 attack, one shadow arm raised high and slamming down toward the viewer; 4 shrinking, the mass collapsing toward the small form as light hits it.

items.name: 탁탁귀병
items.prompt: Taktak-gwibyeong, a ghost soldier of the old town garrison, same height and feet line as the player reference. Drawn only in pale blue-white and gray tones: a tattered Joseon soldier's jacket, a black felt military hat (jeonrip) with a red tassel whose wide brim hides the face so the species cannot be told, hollow dark eye spots under the brim, bony pale hands. The legs fade into pale mist at the ankles, drawn as opaque pale pixels on the magenta key. Holds a long spear two-handed. Walk frames glide; the attack frame thrusts the spear far forward so the tip extends well past the body (two-tile reach). The facing-up row shows the hat from behind.

items.name: 두억시니 (보스)
items.prompt: Dueoksini, the plague ghost and the area boss, twice the size of a searcher. A hunched large figure wrapped in a tattered white mourning robe, long black hair hiding most of a pale mask-like face with two dark hollow eyes, grey-purple sickness blotches on the hands and robe hem (small marks, not wounds), hovering a few pixels above the ground. Four frames: 1 idle facing DOWN toward the viewer; 2 attack facing down, both arms spread wide with a burst of dark purple spores at the hands; 3 idle facing RIGHT; 4 attack facing right, arms thrust to the right with spores. No blood.

items.name: 생사귀
items.prompt: Saengsagwi, the one who comes for those still inside when the gate closes. A tall gaunt figure 32 pixels wide and 64 tall standing on the bottom edge of each 64x64 cell: a long black robe (dopo), a wide black horsehair hat (gat) whose brim hides the face completely, pale bony hands, carrying a dim paper lantern on a short pole. Calm, slow, unstoppable; not monstrous. Four frames, all facing DOWN toward the viewer: 1 idle; 2 idle with the lantern swaying; 3 walking, one foot forward; 4 reaching out one hand toward the viewer.

items.name: 도깨비불
items.prompt: Dokkaebi-bul, a will-o'-the-wisp flame that drifts along roads in a line. One 16x16 flame per cell: a teardrop of blue-green fire with a tiny pale core and a dark blue outline, floating with no base. Four flicker frames: 1 tall and narrow; 2 leaning left with a spark; 3 short and wide; 4 leaning right with a spark.

items.name: 도깨비 장수
items.prompt: A dokkaebi peddler who appears inside the town and trades once. A stout round-bellied figure 32 pixels wide and 48 tall standing on the bottom edge of each 64x64 cell: mossy green skin, one small horn poking out from under a woven straw hat, a wide grin, a huge cloth bundle pack on the back, a long thin pipe in one hand. Four frames: 1 idle facing DOWN; 2 idle with a puff of pipe smoke; 3 talking with one hand held out for trade; 4 idle facing RIGHT.

items.name: 대장장이 (늙은 개)
items.prompt: The camp blacksmith: an old gray-muzzled DOG person with one torn ear, same proportions as the player reference, 32 pixels wide and 48 tall standing on the bottom edge of each 64x64 cell. Heavy leather apron over a sleeveless tunic, thick forearms, a hammer in one hand. Four frames: 1 idle facing DOWN; 2 idle, hammer resting on the shoulder; 3 talking with a short nod; 4 idle facing RIGHT.

items.name: 약제사 (회색 고양이)
items.prompt: The camp apothecary: a slim gray CAT person with round wire spectacles, same proportions as the player reference, 32 pixels wide and 48 tall on the bottom edge of each 64x64 cell. A dark-green hanbok vest over a pale tunic, a small mortar and pestle held at the chest, a pouch of herbs at the hip. Four frames: 1 idle facing DOWN; 2 idle, pushing the spectacles up; 3 talking, pointing at the viewer's arm as if assessing a wound; 4 idle facing RIGHT.

items.name: 수집가 (검은 고양이)
items.prompt: The camp collector who buys valuables and sells keys: a sleek black CAT person with green eyes, same proportions as the player reference, 32 pixels wide and 48 tall on the bottom edge of each 64x64 cell. A deep-red silk vest with a thin gold trim, a small abacus in one hand, a ring of keys at the belt. Four frames: 1 idle facing DOWN; 2 idle, flicking an abacus bead; 3 talking with a sly half-smile and one hand out; 4 idle facing RIGHT.

items.name: 타일: 야영지
items.prompt: Tileset for the searchers' camp by a stream outside the town wall at dusk: warm campfire orange against cool blue-gray ground. 1 packed dirt ground; 2 dirt with sparse dry grass; 3 short grass; 4 stream water, calm dark blue with two pale ripple lines; 5 stream bank, dirt on the top half meeting water on the bottom half; 6 campfire burning in a ring of stones; 7 tent roof left half, patched canvas; 8 tent roof right half; 9 tent front wall with a dark open flap; 10 a wooden name board on two posts with rows of small carved notches and no letters; 11 a gray boulder; 12 a log bench; 13 stacked wooden storage crates; 14 anvil on a stump beside a small forge; 15 a shelf of clay jars and hanging herbs; 16 a low table with folded silks and a small scale.

items.name: 타일: 민가 골목
items.prompt: Tileset for the abandoned house alleys just inside the gate: overcast daylight, ash-gray and cool blue tones with dusty brown dirt. 1 dirt road; 2 dirt road with a few embedded stones; 3 dirt road with dry weeds; 4 stone-and-mud wall TOP, seen from above with gray roof tiles capping it; 5 stone-and-mud wall FRONT face, stacked rough stones and mud; 6 wall corner where the top meets a front face; 7 gray curved roof-tile surface (giwa) used as a rooftop filler; 8 a wooden plank door, closed; 9 the same door open, showing dark interior; 10 the same door closed with a rusty chain and padlock across it; 11 a cluster of large dark clay jars (jangdok) on a stone platform; 12 a stone well with a wooden lid; 13 a raised wooden floor (maru) of a house; 14 a heap of broken roof tiles; 15 a bare dead tree trunk; 16 solid near-black void for unseen areas.

items.name: 타일: 저잣거리
items.prompt: Tileset for the dead market street: narrow lanes of flagstones between shuttered shops, the lanterns all out, same palette family as the alley reference but with more worn wood. 1 flagstone paving; 2 flagstone paving with a cracked stone; 3 wet flagstones with a dark puddle; 4 shop wall TOP with gray roof tiles; 5 shop wall FRONT with a shuttered wooden window; 6 shop corner post; 7 a faded cloth awning seen from above; 8 an empty wooden market stall table; 9 a shop door, closed; 10 the same door open to a dark interior; 11 the same door closed with a chain and padlock; 12 a stone lantern post with the lamp dark; 13 a stone-lined canal of dark water; 14 three stone steps going down; 15 an overturned wooden cart with a broken wheel; 16 solid near-black void.

items.name: 타일: 관아 지하
items.prompt: Tileset for the cellars under the magistrate's office: cut-stone vaults, almost black with cold blue-gray stone and a single warm orange where a torch burns. 1 dark flagstone floor; 2 flagstone floor with a crack; 3 flagstone floor with a shallow puddle; 4 cut-stone wall TOP; 5 cut-stone wall FRONT; 6 wall corner; 7 an iron-banded door, closed; 8 the same door open to blackness; 9 the same door closed with a heavy lock plate; 10 an iron wall bracket with an unlit torch; 11 the same bracket with the torch burning orange; 12 a row of iron bars; 13 stone stairs going up, lighter at the top; 14 stone stairs going down into black; 15 a tall bookshelf of old bound volumes; 16 solid near-black void.

items.name: 소품
items.prompt: Prop sheet. Unlike a tileset each cell shows ONE object on a flat solid magenta #FF00FF background, base on the bottom edge, seen top-down three-quarter. 1 a wooden chest, closed; 2 the same chest open and empty; 3 a small wooden drawer cabinet; 4 an iron strongbox, closed; 5 the same strongbox open; 6 a fallen dog searcher lying on its side, eyes closed, no blood; 7 a fallen cat searcher lying on its side, eyes closed, no blood; 8 a clump of herbs growing from a crack, a harvest node; 9 a small heap of scrap iron, a harvest node; 10 a small dropped cloth bundle tied with string, the generic dropped-item marker; 11 a single large clay jar; 12 the same jar broken; 13 a wooden barrel; 14 a bronze bell hanging from a wooden post; 15 a short wooden marker stake with a strip of red cloth tied to it; 16 a cold campfire, ash and charred logs.

items.name: 탈출구와 성문
items.prompt: The five extraction points and the town gate, each a 64x64 object. 1 the side door: a small arched wooden door set in a section of stone town wall; 2 the collapsed wall: a gap of tumbled stones in the wall with a knotted rope hanging down it; 3 the cart: an empty two-wheeled wooden cart with a small lit lantern hanging from its front; 4 the water gate: an arched iron grate over a dark canal where it passes under the wall; 5 the cellar door: a heavy stone door with iron bands and a large keyhole, half sunk into a stone floor; 6 the town gate: the big closed double gate of the walled town with a tiled roof over it, seen from outside.

items.name: 아이템 아이콘: 무기·방어구·장비
items.prompt: Inventory icons for gear, each drawn diagonally or front-on so it reads at 16x16. 1 dagger; 2 hand axe; 3 long sword; 4 spear; 5 flanged iron mace; 6 small throwing knife; 7 a fist-sized stone; 8 plain hemp tunic, folded; 9 leather jerkin; 10 chain-mail shirt; 11 plate cuirass; 12 round wooden shield with an iron boss; 13 burning torch; 14 small cloth backpack; 15 large leather backpack with straps; 16 coil of rope.

items.name: 아이템 아이콘: 소비품·귀중품·재료·열쇠
items.prompt: Inventory icons for consumables, valuables, materials and keys, matching the gear icon reference. 1 rolled linen bandage; 2 wooden splint with cord; 3 a small folded paper packet of painkiller powder; 4 strip of dried meat; 5 silver cup; 6 jade ring; 7 small stoppered medicine bottle; 8 folded bolt of silk; 9 scrap of iron; 10 piece of tanned leather; 11 bundle of green herbs; 12 bundle of rope fibre; 13 plain iron key; 14 ornate bronze key with a decorated bow; 15 a bound technique book with a cord tie; 16 a small leather secure pouch with a drawstring.

items.name: UI 아이콘
items.prompt: Status and HUD icons, bold single-idea pictograms with a light fill so they read on dark panels. 1 bleeding: a single falling drop; 2 fracture: a bone with a crack; 3 pain: a jagged spark burst; 4 overweight: a heavy sack with a down arrow; 5 stamina: a small flame; 6 time left: an hourglass; 7 bell: a hanging bell; 8 key slot: a key outline; 9 torch lit: a torch with flame; 10 block: a small shield; 11 stash: a chest; 12 tent: a tent; 13 trader: a coin; 14 name board: a board on two posts; 15 noise: three curved sound arcs; 16 attack warning: an exclamation mark inside a diamond.

items.name: 효과
items.prompt: Small combat effect frames, each centred in its cell with no character. 1 hit spark A: a pale yellow-white four-point star burst; 2 hit spark B: the same burst larger and broken into pieces; 3 dust puff: three small gray-brown puffs low in the cell; 4 bleed: three tiny dark-red drops scattered low in the cell, small and restrained.
